ValidationRule.description: For Sales Offers Case, user is not allowed to fill up Request Type and Upgrade Tier Requested
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND ( Case__r.RecordTypeId = "01290000001UPUR", /*Sales Offers Request*/ NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'System Administrator'), /*System Administrator*/ NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Administrator'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Admin - Freight'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Admin - QCC'), NOT ( $Profile.Name = 'Qantas System Admin - SND'), OR ( NOT ( ISPICKVAL ( Upgrade_Tier_Requested__c , "")), NOT ( ISPICKVAL ( Request_Type__c , "")) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to pick the values in the Upgrade Tier Requested or Request Type picklist for Sales Offers Type request.
